description: This PHP source file defines the UpdatePasswordController class within the OrangeHRM framework. It extends an abstract controller and utilizes traits and components to manage the update password functionality in the PIM (Personal Information Management) module. The class primarily sets up a Vue component with user information for rendering.

classes.name: UpdatePasswordController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the update password view, setting up the Vue component with the current user's username.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with user data before rendering the page.
